title: Nanoscale spatial-omics via contrastive embedding of single-molecule localisation data
abstract: Omics approaches have transformed biology by characterising cells at the genomic, transcriptomic and proteomic levels. An additional layer of cellular information is provided by the nanoscale spatial organisation of molecules, which can be measured using super-resolution microscopy. We present a self-supervised contrastive learning framework that embeds single-molecule localisation microscopy (SMLM) point patterns into a learned representation of nanoscale organisation. Across simulated and experimental data, the representation distinguishes diverse spatial architectures, captures graded changes in organisation and supports unsupervised comparison of experimental conditions. The framework distinguishes proteins with different nanoscale distributions and captures variation associated with cell type and pharmacological perturbation. In a direct comparison with six conventional DBSCAN- and Ripley-derived spatial descriptors, the learned representation showed stronger correspondence with protein identity during unsupervised clustering, while conventional descriptors retained substantial discriminatory information. Together, these findings establish contrastive representation learning as a complementary, scalable framework for comparative nanoscale phenotyping and hypothesis generation.

llm.novelty_zh: 将自监督对比学习用于单分子定位显微（SMLM）点模式的纳米级空间组织表征，并与六种 DBSCAN/Ripley 类传统空间描述符直接比较。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作提出自监督对比学习框架，把 SMLM 点模式嵌入到纳米级组织的学习表征中，在模拟与实验数据上区分不同空间结构并捕捉渐变变化。作者用该表征区分不同蛋白的纳米分布以及细胞类型与药理扰动相关的变化，并与六种传统空间描述符做无监督聚类比较。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 这是把表示学习引入超分辨单分子空间组学的尝试，为细胞内蛋白纳米级组织的比较表型分析提供了新工具。其与传统描述符的直接对比也为后续方法评估提供了参照。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出具体数据集规模、基线的详细设置、代码与数据是否开源，且与虚拟细胞或扰动响应预测的直接关系较弱，属于空间超分辨成像方向的表征工作。

title: Learning interpretable rules of protein binding from a trillion interactions
abstract: Protein binders are invaluable as research tools and therapeutics, yet why some targets readily yield binders while others resist discovery remains poorly understood. Here we quantify this variability through more than 1,300 independent selections against 96 protein targets, experimentally surveying over one trillion protein-protein interactions. We find that binder density-the probability that a random protein variant binds a target is reproducible, varies by at least five orders of magnitude, and depends primarily on target identity rather than library design. To uncover the molecular determinants of binding, we develop an energy-based machine-learning model that learns pairwise interactions between target and binder residues from protein language model embeddings, and introduce a decomposition that resolves these interactions into interpretable feature-feature couplings. Strikingly, the features associated with binders are extensively shared across targets, whereas those associated with targets are largely unique. These features both recover established molecular recognition mechanisms and identify previously unrecognized interactions in natural proteins. Several of the newly predicted interactions are validated experimentally. Our findings establish a quantitative framework for binder discovery and reveal a shared, interpretable, and transferable molecular vocabulary for predicting protein-protein interactions.

llm.novelty_zh: 通过超过 1300 次独立筛选、约万亿级蛋白-蛋白相互作用的实验测量来量化 binder density，并提出基于 PLM 嵌入的能量模型与特征-特征耦合分解，以可解释方式揭示结合规则。
llm.summary_zh: 该研究对 96 个蛋白靶标进行了 1300 余次独立筛选，实验覆盖超过一万亿次蛋白-蛋白相互作用，发现 binder density 可复现且主要由靶标身份决定，变化幅度至少五个数量级。作者用基于蛋白语言模型嵌入的能量模型学习靶标与结合蛋白残基之间的成对相互作用，并将其分解为可解释的特征耦合，发现结合特征在靶标间高度共享，而靶标特征较为特异，部分预测的新相互作用获得实验验证。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把 binder 发现的难易差异转化为可定量的实验与建模框架，对蛋白设计和结合预测都有直接参考价值。其大规模实验数据与可解释的相互作用规则，也为理解蛋白识别机制提供了新视角。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未说明模型在未见靶标或天然蛋白复合物上的泛化能力，也未提及数据与代码是否公开；其与虚拟细胞的直接关联较弱，主要属于蛋白设计外围。
